_comment: Single source of truth for the homepage hero stat tiles (index.html .home-stat block). Bump a value HERE and re-deploy; scripts/check_home_stats.py fails if the hero tiles drift from this file. Each entry names the authoritative source so the value can be re-derived when the underlying research advances. Lives at scripts/ for now (in SITE-EDITOR/BULK-EXECUTOR scope); when build-time injection lands (follow-on B, handoff/dispatch/letter_count_grounding_followon_2026-07-03.md) relocate to _data/program_stats.json so Jekyll can template the hero tiles from it, and register _data/ in SITE-EDITOR scope. The federal-comment-letter count is NOT here: it is derived from published letter pages by scripts/check_letter_count.py.

home_stats.label: Governance protocols audited
home_stats.source: B2 Governance Concentration paper: N=52 protocol cross-section (DePIN, DeFi, L1/L2 infrastructure, social tokens). Corroborated on papers/governance-concentration, papers/who-burns-the-tokens, research/index.html, docs/KEY_FINDINGS.md.

home_stats.label: Stablecoin gateways mapped
home_stats.source: Routing the Dollar / CLII: 19 gateway entities scored across five regulatory dimensions. Corroborated on papers/routing-the-dollar, research/index.html, docs/KEY_FINDINGS.md F-A1-2. (The counterparty-network sub-analysis uses a 15-gateway subset; the headline is 19.)

home_stats.source: Routing the Dollar: $60.6T cumulative stablecoin transfer volume across nine blockchains, Feb 2023 through Jan 2026, Artemis-filtered. Corroborated on papers/routing-the-dollar.
